refnamediv.refpurpose: Close the active archive and return it as a string

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
public stringfalseZipArchive::closeString
Closes an archive that was opened with ZipArchive::openString, saves any changes, and returns the resulting archive as a string.
As with ZipArchive::close, a new archive that contains no entries is not written. In that case an empty string is returned, which is not a valid ZIP archive.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns the contents of the archive as a string, or &false; on failure. When it fails, a warning is raised and the reason is available from ZipArchive::getStatusString.

&reftitle.errors;
Throws an Error if the archive was not opened with ZipArchive::openString, and a ValueError if the archive is not open, for example because it has already been closed.
